_comment: A small bundled list of servers with prefilled commands (§7.2). Static on purpose: no remote fetching, no registry API. Kytto is not a catalog product — this exists so the first server is easy to add, not to be comprehensive.
_verification: Every package below was checked against the npm and PyPI registries on the date above, and against the modelcontextprotocol/servers README. Most of the servers people expect here — GitHub, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Puppeteer, Brave Search, Slack, Google Drive — were archived by the MCP project and are deliberately absent rather than shipped broken. Re-verify before every release.

servers.name: filesystem
servers.description: Read, write and search files in directories you explicitly allow.

servers.name: memory
servers.description: A knowledge graph the model can write to and recall across conversations.

servers.name: sequential-thinking
servers.description: Lets the model break a problem into explicit, revisable steps.

servers.name: git
servers.description: Read, search and inspect the history of a local repository.

servers.name: fetch
servers.description: Fetches a web page and converts it to markdown for the model to read.

servers.name: playwright
servers.description: Drives a real browser: navigate, click, fill forms, take screenshots.

servers.name: context7
servers.description: Up-to-date documentation and code examples for libraries.

env.hint: Optional. Raises the rate limit; get one at context7.com.

servers.name: firecrawl
servers.description: Scrape, crawl and search the web through the Firecrawl API.

servers.name: github
servers.description: Repositories, issues and pull requests. The official hosted server — no install, sign in through your client.
servers.requires: A client that supports remote MCP servers with OAuth

servers.name: everything
servers.description: Exercises every part of the MCP protocol. Useful for checking that a client is wired up correctly.
